messages.author: a7f2fddb1460b029
messages.subject: rstan 2.7 not working on Wndows 7
parts: Hi, I am not being able to compile using rstan 2.7 on a machine running Windows 7. I've found others have encountered similar problems (e.g., https://groups.google.com/d/topic/stan-users/UpobnCbuH3c/discussion), but I've not been able to make work any of the proposed solutions. I'm attaching a complete trace. Would greatly appreciate any guidance.

messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: Re: rstan 2.7 not working on Wndows 7
parts:
On Saturday, September 19, 2015 at 12:39:09 AM UTC-4, anmaos wrote:
Hi, I am not being able to compile using rstan 2.7 on a machine running Windows 7. I've found others have encountered similar problems (e.g., https://groups.google.com/d/topic/stan-users/UpobnCbuH3c/discussion), but I've not been able to make work any of the proposed solutions. I'm attaching a complete trace. Would greatly appreciate any guidance.

That thread was due to using the wrong flags in ~/.R/Makevars for a Windows machine. This thread

https://groups.google.com/d/msg/stan-users/qyR4_fi7ZOM/feByXKILBAAJ

is the one that applies to the mismatch between StanHeaders and rstan on CRAN. Or see

https://github.com/stan-dev/rstan/issues/211

Ben
